The '''Kamino system''' was a remote [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the far reaches of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] above the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] plane and due to this, it was sometime considered [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]]. It laid close to the satellite galaxy known as the [[Rishi Maze/Legends|Rishi Maze]]. Its aging primary sun was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by thirteen [[Planet/Legends|planets]], out of which the fourth, [[Faa (planet)|Faa]] and the fifth, [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] were terrestrial.

Kamino had once been a world largely covered with land, but an an abrupt climate change around [[19,000 BBY]] melted its glaciers, submerging the landmasses beneath hundreds of meters of [[Water/Legends|seawater]] in two centuries. The [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] inhabitants of the planet, the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] lost their dryland cities and architectural treasures, such as the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Derem City]] and the [[Clock Spires of Harai Nova]]. However, their technology permitted them to move into stilted cities rising above the global ocean, and their genetic knowledge made the preservation of many drowned [[Species/Legends|species]] possible through [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]]. Such engineering also shaped the Kaminoans themselves into a nearly uniform race.

In [[4500 BBY]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] made contact with Kamino, whose superiority in the field of cloning brought a number of breeding requests from various locations. More than [[32 BBY/Legends|four millennia later]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]] placed an order for a [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone army]]. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] oversaw the project's completion, ensuring its secrecy by having Kamino deleted from stellar databases. The [[Army/Legends|army]] eventually participated in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] on the side of the Republic, fighting against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Three battles took place in the system&mdash;[[Battle of Kamino/Legends|one]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[First Battle of Kamino|another]] in 21.83 BBY and a [[Battle of Kamino (Separatist–Mandalorian invasion)|third]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19.42 BBY]], which devastated the cloning facilities.

After the end of the war, Kamino became a [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], dedicated to expand the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]], and the [[Kamino uprising|clone uprising]] of [[12 BBY/Legends|12 BBY]]&mdash;orchestrated by rebellious cloners&mdash;was rapidly quelled. In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]]&mdash;a renegade clone of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] secret apprentice, [[Galen Marek]]&mdash;and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] also [[Assault on Kamino|assaulted]] the planet to free Starkiller's lover, [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]].

The shattering of the Empire in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] brought about an economic collapse on Kamino, which was forced to survive on smaller contracts, often with [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] or gangsters&mdash;a practice the world was still holding in [[43 ABY]].

==Description==
The Kamino system was located in farthest reaches of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]],<ref name="GATORW" /> and was considered [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] due to being above the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] plane in a loose cluster of [[Star/Legends|stars]] at the lower end of the satellite galaxy known as the [[Rishi Maze/Legends|Rishi Maze]]. Its primary sun, [[Kamino (star)|Kamino]]<ref name="atlas" /> was an aging star,<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''&mdash;In-game description</ref> [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by thirteen [[Planet/Legends|planets]]&mdash;the molten world [[Kas]], the searing rocks [[Yuka Major]] and [[Jomon]], terrestrial [[Faa/Legends|Faa]], oceanic [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], barren [[Mira (planet)|Mira]], [[Miyuu]] and [[Donoa]], the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] [[Casna Aure]] and [[Casna Besh]], the frozen rocks [[Imoco]] and [[Talita]] and the ice ball [[Yuka]].<ref name="atlas" />

==History==
===Pre-Republic===
The [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Species/Legends|species]], long-necked [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]], evolved on Kamino, the fifth planet in the system. They soon developed the coasts of their largely landlocked world, building cities like [[Derem City]]. However, a climate change in [[19,000 BBY]] melted Kamino's glaciers, and two centuries later, all landmasses were submerged beneath several hundred meters of [[Water/Legends|seawater]]. The Kaminoans moved into stilted cities rising above the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]], and their knowledge of genetics allowed the preservation of several drowned species through controlled [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]]. Genetics also shaped the Kaminoans: their attempts at reaching perfection resulted in a near uniformity of thought, appearance and mannerism.<ref name="atlas" />

===Contact with the galaxy===
In [[4500 BBY]], contact was made with [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]]. Since Kaminoan cloning was superior to contemporary methods, a number of orders were made by both nearby and farther contractors, which resulted in breeds like the [[Limb/Legends|shovel-handed]] [[Miner/Legends|miners]] of [[Subterrel/Legends|Subterrel]] and the [[Leech Legion]] of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The Kaminoans also modified<ref name="atlas" /> the flight-capable cetacean [[Aiwha/Legends|aiwhas]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="DB-aiwha">{{DB|creature|aiwha|aiwha}}</ref> for themselves.<ref name="atlas" />

===Clone Wars===
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]] commissioned the Kaminoans to breed an [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|army]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] for the Galactic Republic.<ref name="atlas" /> The Kaminoans ewith the inhabitants of the nearby [[Rothana system/Legends|Rothana system]] to build advanced combat machinery so that the army could be supplied with weapons and [[Transport/Legends|transportation]].<ref name="DB-Kamino">{{DB|location|kamino|Kamino}}</ref> The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] ensured the project's secrecy by erasing the world from stellar databases.<ref name="atlas" /> His [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], also removed the mentions of the planet from the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]].<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>

[[22 BBY/Legends|Ten years later]],<ref name="Blog-holocron|13/comments">{{Blog|holocron|13/comments|Major Character Birth Years}}</ref> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] visited the planet while investigating the origins of a [[Mk I Saberdart/Legends|Kamino saberdart]] that was used to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]]. In a meeting with [[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]], the incumbent [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] of Kamino, Kenobi learned of the clone army, of which 200,000 units had been completed.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref>
